metadata.original_query:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "left indwelling catheter", "B": "right indwelling catheter"}
metadata.retrieval_focus: Identifying and localizing medical devices such as catheters in radiographic images by determining laterality (left vs right) and verifying placement through visual inspection of anatomical landmarks.
